description: Congressional Candidate Trygve Hammer will administer the tip-off at the 4 Bears Roar game in New Town on Saturday, May 9. The 4 Bears Roar will play the Mesa Monsoons. This is The Roar’s first season—they are part of The Basketball League (TBL).
